listing.name: The Tellasian League
listing.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with unique ships, a refit hullmod, and an AI Switch hullmod that allows ships to be crewed by either human or AI captains.

description:
The Tellasian League

By Xxarra

Faction Description

Credits

Simbach A. Vazo - Faction Flag/Crest, Writing Help

Junksters - Description re-writes

Joya! - Initial written description versions

Maruko - Initial Nest Class description

Purple Nebula - Coding help, advice, general support

Tartiflette - Sprite usage in kitbashing the Elucidation (TLL)

ICOMDESIGN - Alpine planet type

TouchOfVanilla - Coding Help, code for the corebridge deco application from VRI

Faction Lineup

AI Switch Hullmod

Tellasian League ships are equipped with the AI Switch hullmod, which allows their ships to be crewed by either human, or AI captains, albeit with a penalty to utilizing AI cores in comparison to standard Automated ships.

Tellasian League Refit Hullmod

Notice:

This mod requires MagicLib to function, and includes both Nexerilin and Commissioned Crews functionality. It cannot be added to existing saves.

Support

If you want to support my work, you can do so via ko-fi!
You can also follow me there for free for blog posts and progress updates.
Any level of support is deeply appreciated!

Changelog

Spoiler
v0.6 - Initial Release

v0.6.1 - Implemented fleet greetings and flavor text for relation levels in the faction intel screen, added description to the Champion (A) (TLL). Fixed Codex description for the AI Switch hullmod. Changed faction fleet prefix from TLL to TDF. Added custom rank names.
